If a subject teacher is writing the letter...

Kindly ask him / her to focus on the following points when writing it. 
	．Your interest in the subject 
	．Did you demonstrate intellectual curiosity 
			throughout the course? 
	．Were you able to kick off class discussions? 
	．How have you contributed to the class? 
	．How many students are in the class? How
			do you work and collaborate 
			with fellow students?

Here are a few things you need to check before your first day of school.

In the United States, every university requires all students to provide vaccination records before enrollment. Depending on the regulations of each state, the vaccination dates should be filled out on the form provided by the school. Some schools may require the form to be signed by a physician, and to be uploaded to the school’s system along with the required vaccination record.

As a first year student at the university, it is important to keep an eye out for general education courses and required courses for your selected major. Certain courses require a placement test, which can be waived with AP exams. International students must take at least 12 credits per semester to maintain a valid student visa. Remember to ask for suggestions on course selection from your school’s academic advisor, senior students and external sources, such as Rate My Professor,

You may check your tuition fee by logging into your university portal, which may vary depending on your chosen program. The minimum payment and due date will be indicated on the tuition bill. You will be paying one semester or one academic year at a time.
Here are a few things you need to check before your first day of school as an international student.

When applying for a Canadian visa, you will need to make an appointment with a hospital to complete a medical examination. After the examination, you will receive a confirmation slip, (not the results). The hospital will upload a medical report directly to the visa center. Remember to take a photo of the confirmation slip for your record.

72 hours before boarding — After downloading ArriveCan App and filling out the E-Gate/Custom Declaration forms, you will receive a confirmation email indicating a set of Reference Number/QR Code. Please save the QR Code in your phone as you will need it for scanning when going through customs.

androidx.appcompat.widget.AppCompatCheck.android:text: Entering the U.S. on a student visa

androidx.appcompat.widget.AppCompatTextV.android:text: Students with a student visa could enter the U.S. within 30 days before the school start date listed on the I-20. While you may want to visit the U.S. in the summer and head to the school right after, holders of student visas can only enter the U.S. as tourists in June. If doing so, they must leave the U.S. before the start of the academic year and re-enter the country with a valid student visa.
More on Entering the U.S. on a student visa

When entering Canada for the first time, be sure to bring your passport, eTA, and the approval letter for study permit. Additionally, have your acceptance letter and tuition fee receipt at hand. Bring these documents with you in your carry-on.

Students who apply for a visa from certain countries are required to complete a TB Test (https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk).
The U.K. provides international students with free COVID-19 vaccines. You could make reservations and check the latest regulations on the NHS website: https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/covid-19/covid-19-vaccination/about-covid-19-vaccination
